test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that means the same as the given sentence.

Shyama looks innocent, but in reality, she is cunning.

options.text: Beauty lies in the eyes of the beholder.
Don’t judge a book by its cover.
Don’t put all your eggs in one basket.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Don't judge a book by its cover"** means that one should not judge the value or worth of something or someone based solely on outward appearances. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को केवल बाहरी दिखावट के आधार पर नहीं आंकना चाहिए।) • **Example: **Just because he dresses shabbily doesn't mean he's not a successful businessman. Don't judge a book by its cover. • **Shyama looks innocent, but in reality, she is cunning** implies that appearances can be deceiving, which aligns perfectly with the idiom "Don't judge a book by its cover." (शयामा मासूम दिखती है, लेकिन वास्तव में वह चालाक है।) • **Example: **Although the house looked small from the outside, it was surprisingly spacious inside. Don't judge a book by its cover. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Fortune favours the brave** (साहसी लोगों का भाग्य साथ देता है): This idiom means that people who take risks often succeed. • **Example:** She decided to start her own business, and it turned out to be very successful. Fortune favours the brave. • **Beauty lies in the eyes of the beholder** (सौंदर्य देखने वाले की आँखों में होता है): This means that the perception of beauty is subjective. • **Example:** He finds modern art beautiful, while others don't. Beauty lies in the eyes of the beholder. • **Don't put all your eggs in one basket** (सभी अंडे एक ही टोकरी में न रखें): This means one should not concentrate all efforts and resources in one area as one could lose everything. • **Example:** He invested all his money in one company, and it went bankrupt. Don't put all your eggs in one basket. f7:Ta66, The correct answer is: Option(4) i.e. **Sedative**.
